correct.description: Legs start extended, curl the pad toward the glutes with control, hips stay flat against the pad throughout

common_errors.description: Hips lift off the pad to help generate momentum instead of an isolated curl
Curl does not reach full flexion at the bottom

reference_keypoints._equipment_note: "machine" occludes much of the lower body from most camera angles (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §2/§3) -- the keypoint_signature rules above assume the hip/knee landmarks are actually visible, which a real machine setup may not guarantee. Flagged for whoever scopes Stage 5b's camera-framing requirements for this exercise.

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: "top" = legs extended (rest reference, highest knee angle), "bottom" = knee flexed toward glutes (peak, lowest knee angle) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as squat.json.

coaching_cues.setup: Lie face down, pad against your ankles, hips flat
coaching_cues.execution: Curl the pad up with control, keep hips down
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Great set. Hips stayed flat throughout.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.hip_lift_off_pad: Press your hips down into the pad
flag_cues.partial_rom: Curl all the way toward your glutes

knee_injury.modification: Reduce weight and range of motion. Stop if you feel knee pain.

hamstring_injury.modification: Reduce weight and range of motion significantly. Stop if you feel a pull.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you curl.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. asymmetric curl between legs). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.
